x-fc-supplement.title: Poll and event invitation of conversations, kept from the 15-10 copy of the specification
x-fc-supplement.source: spec/funnelchat.json of 2026-10-15 (developers-portal feat/openapi-unificada @ 0ef4abb, sha256 8bbbae569b4cab520884db98f28204156c1bd6c629578bee609343c193e0dadb), copied with its references resolved; checked against conversations tag v1.19.7 @ 4e35ddb835249d37576597cc9a965c3e16ccb6d2
x-fc-supplement.reason: The node had these two operations, and saved workflows may use them. The portal's full unified specification of 2026-11-04 leaves them out because they are not open to API keys (outside the allowed list of conversations v1.19.7, so a key gets 403 route_not_available). They are kept, with that notice, so nothing is removed. If conversations opens them and the specification brings them, the generator uses the specification's and says this supplement is no longer needed.

tags.name: InteractiveMessage
tags.description: Polls and event invitations sent to a contact. Not open to API keys yet.

post.x-fc-purpose: Sends a contact a poll with options, single or multiple choice, for example to learn preferences or confirm an appointment.
Use it to send a contact an invitation to an event with a name, date and time, description and place, such as a webinar or a meeting.
